hero.label: Comparison
hero.title: Choosing a RedNote (Xiaohongshu) scraper: Python libraries, open-source MCP, data platforms or a browser extension
hero.description: The short answer: for a platform-wide creator database and campaign history, use a data platform such as Qiangua, Xinhong or Huitun. If you code and need large scheduled crawls on a server, use an open-source scraper such as MediaCrawler. To have AI publish posts for you, use the open-source xiaohongshu-mcp. To collect the posts, comments and video transcripts you can see, then analyze them in Excel, Lark or an AI agent, use a browser extension such as MediaClaw. MediaClaw is our product, so this comparison sticks to facts each project documents publicly.

items.question: What is the best Python library to scrape Xiaohongshu?
items.answer: Among open-source projects, MediaCrawler covers the most platforms, including RedNote, Douyin, Kuaishou and Bilibili. It needs Python and Playwright and saves to CSV, JSON, Excel or a database. Its repository states learning and research use only, so check the terms before commercial use. If you don't code, a browser extension is simpler.

items.question: Is there a cheaper alternative to Qiangua or Huitun?
items.answer: It depends on what you use them for. For creator databases and campaign data, compare data platforms with each other; MediaClaw has no platform-wide database. If you mostly read specific posts, comments and benchmark accounts, collecting just that with an extension is often cheaper and more flexible.

items.question: Will a scraper get my account banned?
items.answer: No tool can guarantee zero risk. The usual precautions: keep request rates low, avoid long bursts, use a normally logged-in account, follow platform rules, and don't collect or publish personal information. MediaClaw shows a batch plan and risk level before large jobs.

items.question: What is the difference between a RedNote MCP and a RedNote scraper?
items.answer: MCP is a standard that lets AI agents call tools; the data behind it can come from a scraper or a browser extension. The open-source xiaohongshu-mcp visits pages with its own browser and can publish. The MediaClaw MCP server collects through the extension in your own browser and focuses on collection and analysis.

items.question: What RedNote data can MediaClaw collect?
items.answer: Post text and engagement metrics, comments and replies, profile posts and search results, plus video transcripts and image text. Export to Excel, CSV or Markdown, or sync to Lark. It only collects what you can see on the page while logged in.
